events.text: GAP UU (ROOT-CAUSED, the big one) — ALL painted ground is INVISIBLE (terrain raise, mud/tile, water: Images 8-12) because the composed ground shader FAILS WGSL COMPILE and the failure is SILENT. Proof: extracted editorGroundFormula() via v8cli harness, assembled exactly as ensureGroundPipeline does (scene3d_ground_prefix + effect_math + formula + epilogue), ran naga: 'no definition in scope for identifier: U' — 10 catalog fills (water, grass, brick_bodega, crt_screen, fluorescent_panel, neon_tube, pool_tile_vice, wall_flag, wall_sign, quality_pass) reference U.time, authored for the Effect pipeline; the ground prefix defines only S: SceneUniforms (framework/gpu/shaders.zig:1571). grass+water are in DEFAULT_BINDINGS (groundFormula.ts:46) so EVERY boot composes a broken shader. ensureGroundPipeline (framework/gpu/3d.zig:5890) does createShaderModule 'orelse return' — silent → g_ground_pipeline null → ground pass (3d.zig:6828) never draws → painted chunks invisible while flora draws fine (own pipelines). Present at HEAD, not a working-tree regression (11 U.time refs in both). Replacing U.time→0.0 validates CLEAN — single root cause. Fix: expose time via SceneUniforms pad + compose-time rewrite U.time→S.time + make pipeline-compile failure LOUD.

GAP VV — placement ghost frozen on free hover (Images 17-19: filled every neighbor cell, ghost never moved). Root: framework dispatches onMouseMove ONLY under pointer capture — nodeWantsPointerCapture (framework/engine.zig:1568-1572), capture starts on mousedown; free hover delivers NO move events. WorldViewport re-snaps the ghost in onMove (WorldViewport.tsx:302-322) → only updates mid-drag; wheel zoom re-snaps via getMouseX poll (line 366) and rotate/pan re-snap in-drag — hence 'only updates when my camera updates'. The host paint beam is immune because it POLLS SDL mouse state per frame (world_loader.zig:6863-6873). Fix: armed-place hover poll in WorldViewport (16ms self-terminating loop, panStep pattern), skip when snap cell unchanged.

GAP WW — paint/build MODE BLEED (Images 6,10,15: build armed while painting, both UIs claim the click). mapPaint.active and activeCommandId are independent EditorState slices with NO arbitration: patchMapPaint (AppFrame.tsx:1909) never clears the armed build command; runCommand place-piece never disarms paint; ToolOptions hides build controls while painting (ToolOptions.tsx:79) but BuildBar + PIECE(armed) focus stay live; host pointer-claim (__compiled_world_set_paint_mode, WorldViewport.tsx:192-197) silently wins every click. Also: PAINT toggle has NO key binding (WORLD_KEYS p = paint-material, keymap.ts:34). Fix: modal arbitration in AppFrame (arm paint ⇒ disarm build + close BuildBar; arm place ⇒ paint off). HELD from wave 1: AppFrame is shared turf with the origin mesh session (handoff req_2644 caution) — lands wave 2.

GAP XX — boot void ('what the fuck am I looking at': Image 3). A fresh editor boots BLANK by design (BLANKBOOT req_2490, world_loader.zig:3183-3199) but NO chunk exists until Map Paint is ARMED — mapGrowChunk(0,0) only runs inside applyMapPaintEffects' arming branch (stage/mapPaint.ts:137-141). So startup = pure skybox: no ground, no grid, no origin, nothing to orient on; the placed floor floats in la-la land (Image 4). The paint mirror renders any seeded chunk as a slab (world_loader.zig:6929-6963, green tint fallback :7010) — seeding at world-doc mount gives boot-time ground for free. Fix: extract ensureMapSeeded() from the arm branch, call at viewport boot (retry-until-door pattern like WorldViewport.tsx:133-141). Flora 'attached to nothing' (Images 13-14) is UU+XX combined — grass drew on ground that wasn't drawn. Build-palette thumbs (Image 16) = req_2621 gap Y, executing this wave.

WAVE 1 LANDED (4 agents, disjoint ownership): [UU] 7ee89e86d — ground formula compose rewrites U.time→S.time (S.time was already populated per-frame at offset 124, former _pad3; both WGSL declarations renamed), ensureGroundPipeline failures now LOUD ([r3d-ground] ERROR); recomposed WGSL validates clean under naga. [XX+VV] e0cad529f — ensureMapSeeded() extracted from the arm branch, called at viewport boot (retry-until-door); free-hover placement ghost via 16ms poll of getMouseX/Y while Place is armed (skip-on-unchanged-snap, teardown on disarm); headless stderr proves boot seed: '[map-seed] ground seeded — 1 chunk(s) live'. [Y] ec33f34a1 — BuildBar real product-shot thumbs: authored models via authoredMeshData, catalog pieces via new pieceThumbMesh.ts triangulation of the real decompositions (window glass pane translucent, door leaves, roof wedges); bounded 3-row tray, fixed 64x60 tiles, labels never wrap; shot-verified. [TT] 612267e4b on req_2649. DISCOVERED BLOCKER: sdk/dependency-registry.json compiled-world feature never triggers for cart/editor (hmsc-int files only) → rjit shot editor builds WITHOUT the WorldLoader primitive → NO headless world-surface verification possible for this cart; the user's dev host works only because it builds full-flag. Registry trigger fix dispatched to the same agent; integration shot follows it.

UU RESIDUAL (found by the new loud logging + the registry fix making headless shots possible): with U.time fixed, the ground pipeline STILL never builds — the composed formula (188018B) overflows the static g_ground_wgsl_buf (98304B) in ensureGroundPipeline's bufPrint. Second independent silent killer, same symptom; explains why the painted ground likely NEVER rendered since the full-catalog composition landed (req_2494 grew the formula past 96KB). Registry fix 356633098 landed: sdk/dependency-registry.json compiled-world now triggers on cart/editor/world/WorldViewport.tsx → rjit shot editor builds with -Dhas-compiled-world → first-ever headless world-surface verification for this cart (boot shot xx_boot2.png shows the loader's real sky + '[map-seed] ground seeded — 1 chunk(s) live'). Buffer fix dispatched to the ground agent (heap-alloc the assembly buffer, verify by boot shot expecting the material slab).

ROUND CLOSED — supervisor-verified boot shot (uu_ground.png, read personally): the editor boots into a REAL lit gridded ground plane with fog falloff (unpainted hf_ground_rgb branch of the composed formula — correct for a fresh seed), TRI 29k DC 1, zero [r3d-ground] errors, census 'seen=1 collected=1 drawn=1'. Full landing set: 7ee89e86d (U.time→S.time + loud pipeline failures), 2ff07c418 (g_ground_wgsl_buf 96KB static → exact-size heap alloc, no size limit remains; CAVEAT: this 3d.zig commit swept ~160 lines of the mesh session's uncommitted loop-cut/overlay hunks — unavoidable shared-file commit, flagged), e0cad529f (boot seed + free-hover ghost poll), 356633098 (dependency-registry compiled-world trigger for the editor — headless world shots now possible at all), ec33f34a1 (BuildBar real 3D thumbs), 612267e4b (flora caps, req_2649). AWAITING LIVE CRITIQUE: painted materials (mud/water/grass colors) on real strokes, ghost tracking, thumbs in anger — all need the user's rebuilt dev host. HELD FOR WAVE 2: gap WW mode arbitration (AppFrame turf), req_2621 gaps X (skin flow), Z (untextured placed meshes), AA (chunk UI).
